# Wilsons Rib Crib & Express

> Slow-smoked BBQ restaurant at 220 E Presley Blvd, McComb, MS 39648. Ribs and rib tips wet or dry, smoked chicken leg quarters, wings, pulled pork, smoked sausage, turkey legs, oxtails and homemade Southern sides. Open Tuesday-Saturday 11 AM-8 PM and Sunday 11 AM-6 PM; closed Monday. Phone (601) 600-2216. Takeout only (no dine-in seating): order pickup online at https://order.wilsonsribcrib.com/ (pay at pickup), call-ahead pickup, curbside, and delivery through DoorDash and Uber Eats. All cards and cash accepted; no checks. Family owned since 2010.
